# ZIVO

> ZIVO is a free all-in-one super-app combining travel booking (flights, hotels, car rentals), rides and food delivery, a community feed and short-form video (reels), online shop and POS, a jobs board for hiring and applying, plus chat with voice and video calls — one account for everything. Available on iOS, Android, and the web at zivosmedia.com.

ZIVO is operated by ZIVO LLC and is a booking agent (not the merchant of record) for airline tickets. Core features are free, while eligible travel and commerce purchases may be paid. Languages supported: English, Khmer, Arabic, French. ZIVO partners with 500+ travel providers including Booking.com, Expedia, Hotels.com, Hertz, Enterprise, and Avis, and offers direct NDC pricing from 300+ airlines.

## Core services

- [Flights](https://zivosmedia.com/flights): Compare flights from 500+ airlines worldwide. No booking fees.
- [Hotels](https://zivosmedia.com/hotels): Compare hotel prices from 500+ trusted partners.
- [Car rental](https://zivosmedia.com/rent-car): Compare rental car prices from Hertz, Enterprise, Avis and more.
- [Rides](https://zivosmedia.com/rides): Book rides on demand.
- [Eats](https://zivosmedia.com/eats): Order food delivery from local restaurants.
- [Grocery](https://zivosmedia.com/grocery): Order groceries for delivery.
- [Travel insurance](https://zivosmedia.com/travel-insurance): Coverage for trips booked on ZIVO.

## Social & community

- [Feed](https://zivosmedia.com/feed): Personalized social feed of posts and updates.
- [Reels](https://zivosmedia.com/reels): Short-form video shared by the community.
- [Channels](https://zivosmedia.com/channels): Themed channels across topics.
- [Communities](https://zivosmedia.com/communities): Group discussions and shared interests.
- [Trending](https://zivosmedia.com/trending): Currently trending posts and topics.
- [Explore](https://zivosmedia.com/explore): Discovery hub for content, places, and people.
- [Leaderboard](https://zivosmedia.com/leaderboard): Active community contributors.

## Commerce & business

- [Shop](https://zivosmedia.com/shop): Online marketplace for stores selling on ZIVO.
- [Jobs](https://zivosmedia.com/jobs): Job board for posting roles and applying.
- [Business](https://zivosmedia.com/business): Tools for merchants — POS, online shop, jobs.
- [Partners](https://zivosmedia.com/partners): Travel and commerce partner program.
- [API partners](https://zivosmedia.com/api-partners): Integration partners and APIs.
- [Affiliate program](https://zivosmedia.com/affiliate-disclosure): Affiliate disclosures and program info.
